WITH store_sales_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_item_sk,
        i_item_id,
        AVG(ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        AVG(ss_list_price) AS avg_list_price,
        AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt,
        AVG(ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, i_item_id
)
SELECT 
    i_item_id,
    s.avg_quantity AS avg_quantity,
    s.avg_list_price AS avg_list_price,
    s.avg_coupon_amt AS avg_coupon_amt,
    s.avg_sales_price AS avg_sales_price
FROM store_sales_avg AS s
JOIN customer_demographics ON s.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
JOIN date_dim ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN promotion ON s.ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
WHERE 
    cd_gender = 'F' AND
    cd_marital_status = 'W' AND
    cd_education_status = 'College' AND (
        p_channel_email = 'N' OR
        p_channel_event = 'N'
    ) AND
    d_year = 2001
GROUP BY i_item_id
ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100
